Overview

About the 8U Air-Cooled HGX B300 System

This 8U air-cooled Supermicro system runs a full NVIDIA HGX B300 8-GPU board with 2.3 TB of HBM3e and eight integrated ConnectX-8 SuperNICs at 800 Gb/s. Its front-I/O layout keeps networking and service access on the cold aisle.

It is the straightforward way to deploy Blackwell Ultra in existing air-cooled data centers. Intel Xeon 6 is shown here; AMD EPYC variants are also offered.

HGX B300 8-GPU

288 GB HBM3e per GPU, 2.3 TB per system, 1.8 TB/s NVLink.

8× ConnectX-8 SuperNICs

Eight 800G OSFP ports for the compute fabric.

Dual Intel Xeon 6700

Up to 86 cores per CPU and 350 W TDP.

Up to 8 TB DDR5

32 DIMM slots, up to 6400 MT/s.

Air-cooled

Up to 12 heavy-duty fans; no liquid cooling infrastructure needed.

3+3 redundant power

Six 6.6 kW Titanium-level power supplies.

Technical Specifications

Processor & memory

CPUsDual Intel Xeon 6700 series with P-cores, up to 86C/172T, up to 336 MB cache, up to 350 W

GPU

GPUsNVIDIA HGX B300 8-GPU (288 GB each)
GPU memory2.3 TB HBM3e per system

Boot2× M.2 NVMe

Expansion2× PCIe 5.0 x16 FHHL

Chassis & power

Dimensions (H × W × D)356 × 449 × 950 mm
